findings.suggested_fix: Add an S-1 AC: a patient with 1 Scheduled and 1 Cancelled appointment, both starting after now, shows "0 completed · 0 no-show · 1 cancelled · 1 upcoming".
findings.text: No AC has a Cancelled appointment that starts after now. The likeliest wrong upcoming count (any appointment with start > now, whatever its status) passes every S-1 AC. Per the glossary, Cancelled appointments can lie in the future.

findings.suggested_fix: Add an AC with two Completed appointments that differ in date and doctor (for example an older one with Dr B, then 05 Nov 2026 with Dr A). Expect the newer date, Dr A, and a link to that appointment.
findings.text: Every S-3 AC has a single Completed appointment, or leaves the older ones unspecified. Picking the earliest or first-loaded Completed row passes all of them, so no AC proves that the most recent Completed appointment is chosen (REQ-8, REQ-9).

findings.suggested_fix: Split S-5 into a privacy story (AC1, AC2) and a no-regression story (AC3 to AC5).
findings.text: S-5 bundles two independent outcomes: no sensitive details in the summary (REQ-13), and no change anywhere else (REQ-14). Each could be built and tested on its own.

findings.text: S-2 AC2 depends on the Appointments table's row limit but does not name it, so a tester must look up the limit before building the test data.

cites.quote: then each looks and behaves as before and shows no Visit summary

findings.suggested_fix: State the observable check, for example: no 'Visit summary' text and the existing regression tests for these pages still pass.
findings.text: S-5 AC5 says 'looks and behaves as before' across five pages without naming any observable check, which makes it loose as a criterion.

rubric_items.reason: All 14 known REQs in the intent are traced: REQ-1..5,7 in S-1, REQ-6 in S-2, REQ-8..11 in S-3, REQ-12 in S-4, REQ-13..14 in S-5. No assumed REQs exist.
S-1 to S-4 each deliver one outcome. S-5 bundles two separate outcomes: the privacy constraint (REQ-13) and the no-regression constraint (REQ-14).

ACs are Given/When/Then and mostly discriminating (time-zone AC crosses local midnight, past Scheduled case). But no AC excludes a future Cancelled from upcoming, and none has two Completed visits to prove most-recent selection.
Values come from the intent and A-01 (05 Nov 2026, 10:30, label format, Asia/Kolkata). The UTC+05:30 shift is derived inline. Other figures are test data, not limits.
Clear and consistent status terms that match the glossary. A few regression ACs use loose wording such as 'looks and behaves as before'.
